caption: The drawing features two metal ladles with round, deep bowls and long handles, depicted on a plain, light beige background. Both ladles are colored in shades of green, yellow, and brown, giving a tarnished or weathered appearance typical of aged metal. The ladle at the bottom of the image is shown in a horizontal orientation with the bowl facing left and the handle extending to the right, ending in a pointed tip with a small hole near the end. The other ladle is positioned above and slightly behind the first, with its bowl angled to the front right and its handle shorter in view, angled upward and rightward. The handles are dark brown, almost black, and the bowls reflect a variety of colors, mostly green and yellow, with highlights suggesting a metallic sheen. The objects are centrally placed and do not touch or overlap. In the space below the ladles, slightly to the right, there is a red signature reading “Clara F. Moes.”
title: Ladle
